title: Accurate multi-scope provenance performance scenario
description: The ordered workload proves the authored semantic outcome and performance declaration.

parameters.scenario: change membership so one row loses scope A but remains in scope B
parameters.defect: retain stale A, omit B, or attach an edge from a different row
